description:
Upgrade towel storage with an assorted free standing accessorie towel stand featuring 4 pivoting swing arms and solid brass construction in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. The freestanding design needs no wall mounting, making it easy to place where you need it in the bathroom.

- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps protect floors and countertops from scratches
- Offered in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors

- Overall size: 49-Inch H x 12-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
